authorization: parent review and explicit released:true required before --execute

target_config.physical_model: passive effective scalar TM susceptibility; continuous host/inclusion fraction with exact phase plateaus
target_config.material_density: latent pushforward only; many-to-one saturation allowed
target_config.prior_reversible_local: pCN z64 + fixed diagonal reflected Gaussian u2

noise.rule: fixed absolute instrument sigma copied from exposed F3 weak acquisition; never rescaled per P1 parent

target_config.data_definition: total complex scattered receiver field S j; deterministic known-background subtraction would preserve the likelihood
target_config.phase_law: C2 quintic saturated fraction, not peak-normalized
target_config.prior_topology_events: post-decoder fraction thresholds .25/.5/.75, foreground4/background8 connectivity, min4 cells; not generator inputs

replication_gate.selection: trainer-selected fixed validation composite only; no alternate checkpoint or DEV/locked result
replication_gate.replicas: if eligible, run BOTH original-source seed2 and seed3 pairs; no seed2 outcome gate
replication_gate.interpretation: preregistered validation continuation gate; not posterior qualification or independent holdout

replication_order: after all seed1 pairs/gates, eligible families in declared order; seed2 pair then seed3 pair
target_rule: unchanged original Full target; no trainer-math or target changes
failure_rule: stop controller on failed/open/inconsistent job; never automatically replay or replace
resume_rule: explicit --resume may skip verified COMPLETE jobs only; never retry failed/open job
cost_rule: each trainer owns standalone physics Book and both locks; controller idle wall not added again to fit wall
